item.content:encoded:
I'm finally getting around to reading this and I'm so glad I took the time to do it. This is an excellent kicker for your series. Your writing is entrancing and each character feels unique and human, while the atmosphere constantly feels dark and lingering.

I'm smitten. Expect me to leave comments each step I take down this road you have paved.

item.content:encoded:
I hate to do this, but I'm going to have to concede. I've been hitting writer's block hard, and have had too much going on around the house to focus on my writing.

But this is a great tale, and I greatly enjoy your characterization of D-7294, and this is an excellent addition to his canon. I'm definitely going to build off this, when I have more time.

She could have been a professor by now, if she hadn't gotten sidetracked. Teaching undergraduates basic engineering equations by day, getting high off mushrooms and fucking the music theory instructor by night.

And I know precisely where. Funny thing, amnestics.

item.title: autuer poast
item.content:encoded:
Once more in to breaches I cannot gap.
One more chance to second guess your thoughts.
My friends said that you would be a tough nut to crack.
Come back lets settle this up…

Thanks to CaptainKirby, trots, and Lazar in chat! A big thank you to WJS for letting me write D-7294! Props to PeppersGhost for hosting the contest! And jesus fuck to me I need to stop inserting my insecurities into my writing!
